version.changelog: Scope helper routes and remove secret-shaped key examples

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Apple jobs lookup helper that sends requests to Crawlora, with one low-risk overbroad POST option users should be aware of.

dimensions.detail: Network access to https://api.crawlora.net/api/v1 and an API key are expected for this API-backed skill; the base URL is fixed and the helper does not allow redirecting the key to another host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installation, dependency installation, shell profile edits, or system setup beyond setting CRAWLORA_API_KEY is present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The user-facing instructions document GET-based Apple Jobs use, while the helper also accepts POST bodies to the same allowlisted routes; this is broader than needed but not hidden and not aimed at arbitrary hosts or local files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, scheduler, privilege escalation, memory write, credential store access, or local data indexing behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search Apple public job postings and retrieve job details via Crawlora; the documented endpoints and helper route allowlist are limited to Apple Jobs search and job detail.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending Apple job search queries, job IDs, and your Crawlora API key to Crawlora. Avoid passing sensitive personal text as query parameters or POST bodies; the helper would be safer if future versions reject POST and unknown parameters for these GET-only endpoints.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill uses a shell helper and curl without a separate explicit permissions block, but the artifact itself constrains the helper to a fixed Crawlora origin and two Apple Jobs paths.
[E1] expected: External transmission to Crawlora is central to the skill and is disclosed in SKILL.md, reference documentation, and the helper comments; no alternate destination or covert upload path was found.
[T09] unexpected: The scanner's POST-capability concern is supported: the helper permits POST and caller-supplied JSON bodies even though the Apple Jobs endpoints are documented as GET-only. This is unnecessary and worth tightening, but it remains constrained to the fixed Crawlora API origin and allowlisted Apple Jobs routes.
